the store is the one it says
every word record is whole: its forms of its senses' classes, the word itself among them, every sense named and said what it means, every place of the grammar's with what it says
each word record written and read back is the same record
memory holds each taught word as one memory, the record as taught
memory reads none of them as a claim about the world
memory holds each word's senses, what each means and what it is a kind of; a word WordNet has none of, its uses and what it says
each form is held a form of its word ("painted", "paints", "painting" of paint)

the grammar holds how the treebanks used each form, as its entries name the uses ("for" a preposition, a subordinator)
the grammar holds what each preposition says joining a doing to a thing ("for" done_for, has_purpose)
the word names, as each class, what its most used sense of the class means (the verb `paint`, the noun `coating paint`)
English's grammar holds each word

each verb sense PropBank and VerbNet say is the word's carries its PropBank sense and its places (paint.v.01 paint.02 create pictures, paint.v.02 paint.01 put paint on a surface, paint.v.03 paint.03 depict)
the grammar knows what each sense is a kind of (`coating paint` a coating, the verb `paint` an act of creating), as it asks deciding a link
the grammar reads each form of 'paint' as the form of its verb it is
the grammar holds the frames 'paint' is used in (intransitive, transitive)
the grammar holds what each place of 'paint' says (subject done_by, object done_to)
the grammar holds what a preposition after 'paint' says (for done_for)

the grammar reads each form of 'picture' as the form of its verb it is
the grammar holds the frames 'picture' is used in (transitive, that)
the grammar holds what each place of 'picture' says (subject done_by, object done_to)
the grammar holds what a preposition after 'picture' says ()

each word is read back in every example of every sense
